# Axel Peter Kristensen

::: {.lede}
Sociologist and demographer. I study why people in Norway have fewer children, who remains childless, and how economic uncertainty and new family forms shape those outcomes.
:::

I completed my PhD in sociology at the University of Oslo in January 2026, with the dissertation *Fertility Decline and Rising Childlessness: The Roles of Economic Uncertainty, Subjective Perceptions, and Social Parenting in Norway*, supervised by Trude Lappegård. My work combines Norwegian register data with survey data from the Generations and Gender Survey (GGS 2020/2024), a collaboration between the University of Oslo and Statistics Norway.

I work with large-scale quantitative data, mainly in R and Stata, and I am used to turning complex register and survey material into analyses that can be read and used by people outside research. I am currently available for research and analysis positions, in and outside academia.

I am also an editorial assistant for the *European Journal of Population* and reviewer for *Genus*.
